questions.stem: When preparing for the party, Mom asked me to buy a __________ kind of fruit—she said it must befresh and from the local farm.
questions.expl: 句意：准备派对时，妈妈让我买一种特定的水果—— 她说这种水果必须新鲜且产自当地 农场。A. particular 特定的、具体的；B. similar 相似的；C. different 不同的；D. simple 简单的。 根据“she said it must be fresh and from the local farm”(她说必须新鲜且产自当地农场)可知，妈 妈对要买的水果有明确要求，是“特定的” 种类，“particular” 能准确表达“指定的、特定的” 含义，其他选项均不符合语境，故选A。

questions.stem: Fresh vegetables like carrots and spinach __________ lots of vitamins that are good for our health.
questions.expl: 句意：像胡萝卜和菠菜这样的新鲜蔬菜含有许多对我们健康有益的维生素。A. contain 含 有、包含；B. remain 保持；C. promise 承诺；D. return 返回。根据“lots of vitamins”(许多维 生素)可知，此处指蔬菜“含有” 维生素，“contain” 能准确表达“包含某种成分” 的含义， 其他选项均不符合语境，故选A。

questions.stem: When reading a new word, it’s helpful to look at the __________ around it to guess its meaning.
questions.expl: 句意：阅读生词时，查看它周围的语境来猜测词义是有帮助的。A. context 语境、上下文； B. result 结果；C. reason 原因；D. problem 问题。根据“look at…around it to guess its meaning” (查看周围内容猜测词义)可知，此处指的是单词所在的“语境”，“context” 符合语境，其他 选项均无法表达“语言环境” 的含义，故选D。

questions.stem: If you want to remember English words well, it’s a good idea to __________ them several times a day.
questions.expl: 句意：如果你想学好英语单词，每天重复几次是个好办法。A. choose 选择B. repeat 重复； B. return 返回；D. break 打破根据“remember English words well”(记好英语单词)可知，此处 指通过“重复” 来记忆，“repeat” 能准确表达“多次做某事以加深记忆” 的含义，其他选项 均不符合语境，故选B。

questions.stem: Our English teacher tells us to practice speaking English __________—she says daily practice helps improve our skills fast.
questions.expl: 句意：我们的英语老师告诉我们要定期练习说英语—— 她说每天练习有助于快速提高我 们的技能。regularly 定期地、经常地；quietly 安静地；carelessly 粗心地；differently 不同地。根 据“daily practice”(每天练习)可知，老师强调的是“有规律、不间断” 地练习，“regularly” 能准确表达“定期、持续” 的含义，其他选项均不符合语境，故选C。

questions.stem: It’s __________ for children to feel nervous on their first day of school—most kids have this feeling.
questions.expl: 句意：孩子们在开学第一天感到紧张是正常的—— 大多数孩子都有这种感觉。normal 正 常的；dangerous 危险的；difficult 困难的；expensive 昂贵的。根据“most kids have this feeling” (大多数孩子都有这种感觉)可知，这种紧张情绪是“普遍、正常” 的，“normal” 能准确表 达“符合常规” 的含义，其他选项均不符合语境，故选D 。

questions.stem: My grandma has a __________ recipe for making mooncakes—she never tells anyone how to make it.
questions.expl: 句意：我奶奶有一个做月饼的秘方—— 她从来不和任何人说怎么做。A. secret 秘密的、 隐秘的；common 常见的；strange 奇怪的；particular 特别的，特定的。根据“she never tells anyone how to make it”(她从不和任何人说做法)可知，这个食谱是“秘密的”，“secret” 能准确表 达“不公开、保密” 的含义，其他选项均不符合“不告知他人” 的语境，故选D。

questions.stem: Can you help me __________ why my phone keeps turning off?I’ve tried many ways but failed.
questions.expl: 句意：你能帮我弄清楚我的手机为什么总是关机吗？我试了很多方法但都没成功figure out 弄清楚、查明；work out 算出(数学题等)；解决(问题)；take out 拿出；give out 释放，发出， 分发。根据“why my phone keeps turning off”(手机为什么总关机)可知，此处指“查明原因”， “figure out” 能准确表达“弄明白原因” 的含义，其他选项均不符合语境，故选B。

questions.stem: This app can help you edit photos to make the __________ look clearer and more beautiful.
questions.expl: 句意：这个应用程序可以帮你编辑照片，让图像看起来更清晰、更漂亮。A. text 文字；B. image 图像、影像；C. voice 声音；D. video 视频。根据“edit photos”(编辑照片)可知，编辑 照片是为了优化“图像” 效果，“image” 符合语境；“text”(文字)、“voice”(声音)与 照片无关，“video”(视频)和“photos”(照片)不属于同一类别，故选B。

questions.stem: __________ Tom felt very tired, he still finished his homework on time.
questions.expl: 句意：尽管汤姆感觉非常累，但他仍然按时完成了作业。A. Even though 尽管、即使(引 导让步状语从句，表转折)；B. As soon as 一…… 就……(引导时间状语从句)；C. So that 为了、 以便(引导目的状语从句)；D. Because of 因为(后接名词或名词短语，不接句子)。根据“felt very tired”(感觉累)和“finished his homework on time”(按时完成作业)可知，前后句是转折 关系，“Even though” 符合语境，其他选项均无法表达转折含义，故选A。 二、根据首字母完成单词

questions.stem: A. simple
questions.expl: 判断题。根据第四段“So why not try pictures with English words? At the same time listen to recordings of the same group of words. It may help when it comes to memorizing it. ”可知，记单词得最 好的方法是“听录音”和“看图片”，故选D。

questions.stem: A. famous for
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“The forgetting curve is also useful in other subjects. ”可知遗忘曲线对学习有优 势。故选C。

questions.stem: A. letters
questions.expl: 判断题。根据第三段“Long-term memory involves the information you try hard to keep, because it’s meaningful to you (an example is data about family and friends. )”可知，长期记忆通常涉及更重要 的事情，故选B。

questions.stem: How much can we forget 20 minutes after learning according to Ebbinghaus’s tests?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据原文“just 20 minutes after learning, we may forget about 40% of the material”可知， 20 分钟后会遗忘约40%的内容。故选B。

questions.stem: How can the forgetting curve help in history learning?
opts: By helping us write long passages.
By helping us remember math formulas.
By helping us remember the facts clearly.
By helping us talk with others about history.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“One light ring and one dark ring make one year of the tree’s life. ”结合海报中树 木年轮的组数可知，这棵树大约17 岁。故选B。

questions.stem: What is the best title for the passage?
opts: How to Study for Exams Fast
The Best Way to Remember New Words
The Forgetting Curve: A Big Help for Learning
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“The light-colored rings are wood that grew in the spring and early summer, while the dark rings are wood that grew in the late summer and fall. ”可知，深色年轮出现在树木秋季生长的 时候。故选C。

questions.stem: What can we know from the passage?
opts: Reviewing at any time is useless.
Forgetting can be stopped if we study hard.
The forgetting curve has advantages for learning.
The forgetting curve is only good for learning words.

questions.stem: According to the poster, which part of a tree can record the climate?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“These rings can tell us how old the tree is, and what the weather was like during each year of the tree’s life. ”可知，树木的年轮可以记录气候。故选A。
